texts: Why do the lanterns of Aelmere burn every night?

fields.sentence: Why do the lanterns of Aelmere burn every night?

review.notes: "every night" takes the named-slot plus implied-cycle pair (Time e night) + (Every e 1 day) and the habitual correctly carries no tense atom; the definite plural binds as a group witness and the named place by Name. The "of Aelmere" genitive lands on the opaque Possession else-branch, which the possessive of-phrase rule licenses.
